poison_printing_policy: Explicit fixed public five-name reference uses unique original CS2_074/ICC_221/YOP_015/BAR_321/BAR_318 physical faces. Core printings are retained raw evidence, not duplicate weights. This is local printing policy, not inferred official membership or a format-wide Wild pool.
local_policies: All ten assigned past roots and exact GDB_846hp/114016 Tracking are implemented together. Both complete original root primary childIds bind the power; no guessed prefix dependency. Original six executable Poison/corrupted-Poison definitions and metadata remain exact, full732 past candidates and original roles/order remain, no complete original source binding or Standard/CN claim.

Saidan declares the existing native stat-gain profile with only mode=double_positive appended; existing Champion defaults to its unchanged +1/+1 reward. Actual positive Attack and Max Health components of each new original local attachment are added once using the existing typed reward, original physical allocation/attachment budget and ordinary Buff/BuffStoredCard paths. Mixed signed changes do not double reductions; no reward recursion. Aura refreshes, inherited copy materials and unspecified set/temporary/CN ordering retain the native module local contract and are not silently claimed calibrated.

Lumia has native Lifesteal and reacts to original settled positive hero DAMAGE, for either current physical hero. Immunity is the ordinary keyword grant through the rest of the accepted real turn, not a continuous aura or a separate damage executor. Shield/immune zero-damage and healing do not trigger. Later source death or silence does not revoke an already committed grant; original target identity never rebinds another hero. Lethal and exact health-observer ordering stay local rules pending CN.

Naielle installs exact one-cost GDB_846hp. Tracking uses existing private physical own-deck genuine discovery with entity-distinct offers, operation=take, and preserves original entity/enchantments; no fabricated hand copy, draw/fatigue or destruction of unchosen cards. Empty deck means no offer, ordinary shared power payment/usage remains.

Neptulon declares original Overload3 and four replacement Murloc hand draws from the complete current host ordinary collectible pool, no class restriction or executable subset. Face Collector uses existing native Echo/temporary-copy floor/expiry and one ordinary current-pool Legendary minion gift per actual Battlecry; ordinary summons have neither Battlecry nor Echo play.

Dragonqueen checks the current physical deck for duplicates and adds two other random current-pool collectible Dragons with ordinary zero-cost grants, with replacement. Existing global generation identity/source-family exclusions remain. Printed historic changes, current legal format alignment and exact CN timing remain separate.

Putricide requires original completed successful own hand play of a Secret; opponent plays, ordinary SetSecret and automatic CAST do not create another hand play. The new finite public SetRandomSecretFromPool validates the entire eligible current host Hunter Secret inventory through original generation candidates, then excludes actually active duplicate Secret keys/capacity before one original weighted draw. Original hidden SetSecret installation is reused with no CAST/payment/hand card/public random-choice identity. Empty/full/duplicate-only availability consumes no RNG. Eligibility and precise full-area/CN policy are explicit local rules, never executable filtering.

Rotface reacts only to original settled positive self damage with positive original health_after and no doomed_after, plus same original live active residence at body acceptance; a later heal cannot convert an original lethal result into survival. Ordinary complete current-pool Legendary summon, summon quantities/capacity and no Battlecry remain shared.

Hadronox has no native Taunt. Its original Deathrattle captures all actual friendly-at-death Taunt records including duplicates and granted Taunt, excludes lost/silenced Taunt at death and original hidden-zone deaths. Original Resurrect with exact death IDs/count, random order and ordinary capacity generates fresh printed bodies, not enchantment copies; records are not consumed. Exact order and self-Taunt inclusion follow shared death batch/local policy pending CN.

Helbrim actual Battlecry and Deathrattle each draw independently from the complete fixed public five-name Poison list. Membership was obtained from a full public response, never a substring search or current executable subset. Original printing selection, all unit weights and excluded duplicate Core roles are explicit local approximation; exact CN37 original/Core printing and membership are not officially verified. Existing Nitroboost Corrupt path and its exact child remain executable.

MIS_701 remains unbound, YOG_522 partial and all six original special domains remain open. Version/hotfix/CN edge calibration remains deferred. Data/definition count is presence only, not effect or official completeness.
